batches.objective: Make ordinary Vulkan surface capability/configuration admission preserve the requested format and reject unsupported properties explicitly.
batches.rationale: The acquired-image handoff is repaired and physically exercised. The retained surface audit and current native consumer still show static capability arrays and silent format substitution; these are separate live correctness obligations.
batches.nextAction: Trace public GetCapabilities and Configure against the selected device/window surface; reproduce a reported capability that cannot execute or a substituted requested format before editing.
acceptance: Preserve declared format/color-space and usage identities or return an explicit unsupported/validation result before swapchain publication.
Exercise public capability/configuration and rendering through a real window with independent pixel checks and rejected-configuration recovery.
Retain source identities and scoped cost checks; do not re-open completed query, SPIR-V, bundle, attachment or surface-handoff batches.
batches.stopCondition: Stop after capability/configuration admission and its consumer evidence. Frame pacing, other window systems and broader backend decomposition remain separate.
requiredEnvironment: Linux Vulkan and a supported window-system surface; record unavailable validation layers and platform evidence.
